about:
Philatron Wire and Cable operates from Santa Fe Springs, California. The company describes itself as a U.S.-based manufacturer of wire and cable products; no founding year, ownership structure, or founders are disclosed in the available information.

The company produces bulk wire and cable, molded electrical cable assemblies, and specializes in extra-large flexible cables and coiled cords. Its stated capability spans 12 volts to 35,000 volts, 28 AWG to 4,000 MCM, and diameters from 1/16 inch to 3.75 inches. Philatron also provides a free design service for custom cable solutions.

Markets served include airport ground support electrical power, automobile and heavy-duty trucking, consumer, electrical distributors, electric vehicle, entertainment, medical, military, mining, OEM, oil and gas, transportation, and utility and power. Specific product lines include EV cable bulk for assemblies, Hz single jacket assemblies, banded 400 Hz assemblies, and military assemblies.

Philatron positions itself as a full-service custom wire and cable manufacturer emphasizing technology, creativity, and innovation, with a free design service as a stated differentiator.
